design: T2-A independent instrument-set replication: Chai 2026 eBMD leads -> knee OA
exposure: Chai 2026 Nat Genet eBMD (GCST90726625, n=448010 EUR)
scale_note: eBMD (heel ultrasound rank-normal) vs DXA aBMD differ in scale; direction compared, magnitude not
verdict: DIRECTION-CONSISTENT, EFFECT-UNRELIABLE: independent Chai 2026 eBMD instruments give OR>1 under both fixed and random effects, matching the DIRECTION of the DXA-aBMD 31-instrument result, BUT the random-effects estimate is not significant (OR=1.0147, p=0.402) and heterogeneity dominates (I2=68.1%). The fixed-effect significance is not read causally. This is directional corroboration, NOT an independent significant replication; eBMD/DXA scales are not magnitude-comparable.
